scope: Original English Pokemon Red/Blue, m01-m10; exclude Yellow/FireRed/LeafGreen

bp2.title: Bulbapedia Red/Blue walkthrough Part 2
bp2.notes: 送包裹获得图鉴后回访Daisy领取地图；常青市有隐藏药水；Route22对手战可选；满足条件后Oak可赠精灵球。

bp3.title: Bulbapedia Red/Blue walkthrough Part 3
bp3.notes: 森林有精灵球一件、解毒药两件、药水两件，包含两件隐藏物；博物馆门票50；古老琥珀需之后有Cut才能取得。

gf-viridian.title: GameFAQs Red Version guide 64175 — Viridian City
gf-viridian.notes: 精灵中心西北灌木旁有可步行绕行的小路，沿路检查树获得隐藏药水；返乡送包裹之后可领取地图。

coordinate_reference.purpose: Only resolve guide landmarks to coordinates and supplement one-time reward contracts; goals originate in online guides.
